title: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker living in isolation in a hut in Abzan territory, haunted by guilt for what he did as Phyrexia's servant.

entities.name: Nur
entities.description: An irreverent Abzan djinni known as the Wandering Warden, who soothes ancestral maelstroms and befriends Ajani.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Waymaster of the Jeskai who leaves Storm Crane secretly with Elspeth to investigate the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: An archangel and planeswalker whose ascension seems to have burned away much of her humanity; she accompanies Narset to the Crucible.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker stripped of his power and struggling to transform into his draconic form, who lives in a hut in Mardu territory and longs for a realm of dragons.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: A hooded man who approaches Sarkhan, claiming to have something he wants.

entities.name: Young dragon mount
entities.description: An adolescent white dragon who insists on carrying Narset and Elspeth to the Crucible; she is not named.

entities.name: Shiko
entities.description: The spirit dragon Narset rode against the dragonlords.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: A dragonlord who scorched the air at the battle with the rebels.

entities.name: Jaya
entities.description: A friend Ajani attacked and who plummeted from the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who built hedrons on Zendikar and was demanded to heal Ajani.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler whom Ajani served as a slave.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An elder dragon who taught Nahiri to shape hedrons; the hedrons here hold a piece of his life force.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The Jeskai dragonlord, Narset's teacher.

entities.name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
entities.description: A blasted region of Tarkir where the spirit dragons were called, now home to floating hedrons and a gathering dragonstorm.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Glowing monoliths floating in the rift at the Crucible, which hold a piece of Ugin's life force.

entities.name: Arashin
entities.description: The Abzan homeland that has many counselors.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: The clan that left Ajani to himself yet kept trying to help him.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The clan led by the waymaster, whose sky riders keep dragons.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The clan in whose territory Sarkhan has built his hut.

entities.name: Kin-Trees
entities.description: Abzan sacred plants, half living wood and half golden spirit, that bind the clan to its ancestors.

entities.name: Ancestral maelstroms
entities.description: Swirling storms of angry Abzan ancestor spirits left without a Kin-Tree.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane whose compulsion Ajani cites for his past evil.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Storms from which dragons emerge; one begins gathering above the Crucible.

events.summary: Wild dragons tear apart a wounded dragon and it crashes into the grass.
events.quote: And down went the hunted behemoth, crashing shoulder first into a tract of tall grass

events.summary: Ajani kills a gazelle with his axe and reflects on his guilt over what he did while enslaved to Elesh Norn.
events.quote: Ajani struck, and he struck true: his axe cleaved through the gazelle's neck

events.summary: Ajani carries the gazelle home, and something stirs in the dust behind him.
events.quote: Behind him, something in the dust woke.

events.summary: Nur visits Ajani's hut, teasing him as a hero, and brings food.
events.quote: I was given a shameful amount of food and thought I would share it with you.

events.summary: Nur calms an ancestral maelstrom of spirits that gather behind Ajani.
Over a meal, Nur urges Ajani to accept Abzan help and warns he is dying slowly of spirit.
events.quote: This isn't living. This is just a death deferred.

events.summary: Ajani recalls attacking Jaya on the Mana Rig and answers Nur that his isolation might be punishment.
events.quote: Ajani would never forget Jaya's face as she plummeted from the Mana Rig

events.summary: Narset sneaks away from the monastery with Elspeth on a young dragon eager to join the quest.
events.quote: And so Narset saddled the young dragon

events.summary: At the Crucible Narset recalls the battle against the dragonlords on Shiko, and shows Elspeth the floating hedrons.
events.quote: Ugin taught her how to shape them.

events.summary: A mysterious voice calls them to a temple as a dragonstorm gathers overhead; Narset sends her dragon away.
events.quote: Above, a storm began to gather, serrated clouds giving way to the suggestion of eyes, bared teeth.

events.summary: Sarkhan emerges at the Crucible, saying he is looking for hope in the dragonstorm and that all the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons.
events.quote: All of the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons.

events.summary: Elspeth easily defeats Sarkhan, and Narset blasts him when he springs up to stab Elspeth in the back.
events.quote: The blast sent Sarkhan crashing to the ground ten feet away, panting and boneless and stunned.

events.summary: Elspeth sheathes her sword and warns Sarkhan she will kill him if he attacks again.
events.quote: If you attack us again, I'll kill you.

events.summary: Wounded and humiliated, Sarkhan limps back to his hut in Mardu territory, mourning his lost power.
events.quote: He walked for hours from the Crucible to the cold fields of Mardu territory.

events.summary: Taigam introduces himself to Sarkhan, claiming to have something he wants.

relations.note: befriends and tries to draw him out of isolation
former slavish servant of Elesh Norn
relations.quote: he was Elesh Norn's slavish little pet.

relations.note: he raised his axe against her
relations.quote: until he raised his axe against her.
There's been enough death in Tarkir,
Sarkhan lunged, and Elspeth met his blade in an effortless parry
I know Nahiri had built them on Zendikar to bind the Eldrazi.
Ugin taught her how to shape them.
Narset was a child again and trying to decipher one of Ojutai's riddles even as her teacher waited and watched.

relations.note: the Wandering Warden among the Abzan
relations.quote: the Wandering Warden (as she was known among the Abzan)
